package.name: hardware_test_support
package.description: Real-hardware analog of sitl_test_support: bridges real OptiTrack mocap into state_estimator/local_position/odom, gates arm/offboard on an explicit operator trigger instead of auto-arming, and enforces a geofence -- so single_vehicle_cbf_rate_arc can be flown on real hardware without touching the SITL-only stack. None of these nodes are simulation stand-ins; sitl_test_support stays the SITL-only package.
